newsitem.title: USA: Koger Equity completes 3 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Koger Equity completes 3 mln shr placement.

text.p: Koger Equity Inc said on Thursday that it completed a private placement of three million shares of its common stock to an affiliate of Apollo Real Estate Investment Fund II LP for $43.5 million.
Proceeds will be used to repay indebtedness and other purposes, Koger said. Koger said it will add four Apollo designees to the board, which will now have 12 members.

After this purchase and the exercise of options to acquire additional shares from certain existing shareholders, Apollo will own about 22.6 percent of the outstanding shares of the company, Koger said.
Koger Equity said Apollo has the right to increase its ownership to 25 percent of the company.
